shots.say: Imagine living in the United States.
shots.img: cinematic aerial establishing shot of a small coastal american town on a green peninsula at golden hour, documentary photography, 16:9

shots.say: But every time you visit your own country, you first have to leave it.
shots.img: empty two lane highway curving through tall green forest toward a distant checkpoint, overcast documentary photography, 16:9

shots.say: To understand this, we go back to a line drawn on a map.
Diplomats argued bitterly over their western territories.
shots.img: 1840s diplomats around a table with a large map, candlelight, oil painting style, dramatic chiaroscuro, 16:9

shots.say: In 1846 they signed the Oregon Treaty.
shots.img: aged 19th century treaty document with quill pen and red wax seal on a wooden desk, warm candlelight, macro documentary, 16:9

shots.say: The border would run straight along the forty ninth parallel.
shots.img: antique parchment map of the pacific northwest coastline, muted sepia, top down, no text

shots.say: But a straight line does not care about geography.
shots.img: aerial drone shot of a forested peninsula tip surrounded by open ocean, dramatic evening light, 16:9

shots.say: And a whole town was left on the wrong side.
shots.img: weathered wooden welcome sign at the edge of a small coastal town, pines and sea behind, golden hour, 16:9
